name: Gopal Chandra Dey

answers.3 Personal Qualities: Patient, dedicated to fine craft, and deeply respectful of handloom heritage.
answers.Overcoming Life Challenges: During the 2020 lockdowns, our loom village lost supply chains. We organized 12 local weaver families to pool fine cotton yarn and continued weaving.
answers.Lighthearted Memory: When I first learned Jamdani supplementary weft at age 16, I accidentally mirrored a peacock motif backwards and my grandfather laughed saying it was a new secret signature.
answers.Hopes & Dreams for the Future: To establish a permanent handloom training center in Shantipur and train the next generation of master Jamdani weavers.
answers.Craft Beginnings & Attraction: My family has been in pit loom weaving for four generations. The rhythmic sound of the shuttle and the magic of creating intricate motifs from raw silk drew me in as a child.
answers.Master Lineage & Teaching: I was trained by my father Late Narayan Chandra Dey in Shantipur. Today, I mentor 8 junior weavers in our Nadia district atelier.
answers.Learning & Mastery Journey: Over 15 years of daily practice on pit looms with Jacquard cards, mastering pure mulberry warp tension and geometric feather motifs.
answers.Materials & Fiber Sourcing: We use 100% certified mulberry silk from Murshidabad, combed cotton, and real electroplated silver and gold tested zari. Dyes are natural and AZO-free.
answers.Favorite Part & Key Challenges: My favorite moment is rolling the finished 6-yard saree off the loom for the first time. The biggest challenge is fine weft count during monsoon humidity.
answers.Sources of Inspiration: Historical Bengal temple terracotta reliefs, flora along the Hooghly river, and antique Royal Jamdani drapes from the 19th century.
answers.Starting Out on Your Own: Starting with just two pit looms required great courage and savings. Partnering with guilds that appreciate authentic handloom allows us to flourish.
answers.Family Workshop Organization: My wife and sister oversee bobbin winding and warp preparation, my elder brother assists in loom mounting, and I execute the Jacquard needle weaving.
answers.Design & Collaboration Qualities: Fidelity to hand-count density, unwavering patience, and pride in maintaining zero mechanical defects.
answers.Community & Livelihood Impact: We provide regular fair-wage employment to 14 rural families, support women artisans with flexible home spinning shifts, and keep Shantipur's pit loom legacy alive.
